resources.name: Texas Veterans Commission – Veterans Employment Services
resources.description: Get free help finding a job if you are a veteran, spouse, or separating service member. They help with resumes, job search, interview practice, and job fairs. Staff know about veteran hiring rules and can connect you to veteran friendly jobs. They can also connect you to other veteran help, like mental health and money help. Call to set up a first visit or ask how to sign up online.
resources.availability_status: Open for new clients - call for visit times

resources.name: VA Austin Outpatient Clinic (Department of Veterans Affairs)
resources.description: Get mental health help, medical care, and support if you are a veteran enrolled in VA health care. resources.availability_status: Open - some mental health visits may have a wait list
